_comment: PLACEHOLDER SCHEMA -- not real data. Copy this to section_mapping.json and fill in with the actual CSV column headers and answer options once the real survey export is available. See README.md.
_column_matching: The 'column' value can be an exact header (e.g. 'Name') or, for Google-Forms-style exports where headers are prefixed like 'Q8: ...', just the stable prefix (e.g. 'Q8') -- matching by prefix survives header text being truncated or re-encoded on export.
ignored_columns: REPLACE: any platform/bookkeeping column that isn't survey content, e.g. a pre-computed Score/Max/Rank -- these are dropped entirely rather than shown to the AI, since a raw numeric field like 'Score: 11/Max: 12' can anchor the AI into the wrong scoring scale

options_low_to_high: REPLACE: lowest-maturity option text, exactly as it appears in the CSV
questions.full_question: REPLACE (optional): the full, untruncated question text from the actual question bank/form -- CSV exports often truncate long headers with '...', and the AI only ever sees what's here. If omitted, the (possibly truncated) 'column' header text is used instead.
